verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows a developer-facing MCP server that lets external coding tools (Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Desktop) interact with the Embedded Payroll API/docs for building integrations — this is a dev-tooling feature, not a built-in AI assistant inside the product that end-users can delegate payroll/HR tasks to. No evidence of an in-app AI assistant for task delegation by end-users.
